## Checklist

- [ ] I opened every link in a fresh browser session and it loads.
- [ ] Each resource is free to use and needs no signup.
- [ ] Lines match the format in [docs/STYLE.md](https://github.com/shuhrat-kobulov/frontend-roadmap/blob/main/docs/STYLE.md):
      `- [Title](https://example.com/) — Description of what it is.` — em dash, capital, full stop.
- [ ] One resource per line, appended to the end of the right section.
- [ ] No duplicates of anything already listed.
- [ ] No unrelated lines reordered or reformatted.
